module fifo_09 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input credit_ret,
  input send_req,
  output tx_valid,
  output [3:0] credits_avail
);

  reg [3:0] credits_reg;
  reg tx_valid_reg;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      credits_reg <= 4'd8;
      tx_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      if (credit_ret) begin
        credits_reg <= credits_reg + 4'd1;
      end else if (send_req) begin
        credits_reg <= credits_reg - 4'd1;
        tx_valid_reg <= 1'b1;
      end else begin
        tx_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
      end
    end
  end

  assign credits_avail = credits_reg;
  assign tx_valid = tx_valid_reg;

endmodule
